This is a match 3 game with a mathematical twist.  Your goal is to complete each level by changing all blue tiles to yellow.  Make matches over blue tiles to turn them to yellow.  A match is made when 3 or more candies of the same color line up horizontally or vertically on adjacent squares.

Each candy has a statement in it about rounding numbers.  Determine if the statement is true or false.  Click/tap the TRUE or FALSE button at the bottom then click/tap on the candy.  Answering true of false correctly will cause the candy to be crunched and the candies above it to shift down one spot.  Answering incorrectly will cause you to lose one life.  Lose 5 lives and the level ends.  Complete each level before the times reaches zero.

Each candy has a division problem with a quotient.  Determine if the division statement is true or false.  Click/tap the TRUE or FALSE button at the bottom of the screen and then click/tap on the candy.  Answering true or false correctly will cause the candy to be crunched and the candies above it to shift down.  Answering incorrectly will cause you to lose a life.

This is a match 3 game with a mathematical twist.  Your goal is to complete each level by removing all of the dark boxes surrounding each candy.  Make matches with items to remove the dark boxes surrounding them.  A match is made when 3 or more of the same type candy line up horizontally or vertically.
